questions.question: Manu Bhaker, D Gukesh, Harmanpreet Singh and Praveen Kumar were recipients of which sports honour in 2025?
options: Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award) है।

questions.question: Who among the following authors won the Sahitya Akademi Award 2021 for his autobiography ‘Hrudayaragangal’?
Tamladu Festival is celebrated by Digaru Mishmis, a tribe from _____.
Which of the following diagnostic classifications enables better international reporting of health conditions, including traditional medicine?
What key feature distinguishes Mesolithic tools from those of earlier periods?
On 27 June 2025, India introduced its first AI-powered ATMS on which expressway?
The Boiler Bill, 2024, passed in Rajya Sabha in December 2024, intends to replace the _______.
Which of the following Indian players clinched gold at the Paris Diamond League 2025 in June?
In which of the following states is Rajgir Mahotsav celebrated?

In May 2024, at which city did the Indian Air Force firstly test Bharat Health Initiative for Sahyog Hita and Maitri (BHISHM) portable cubes hospital, which can be deployed to cater to emergencies anywhere?
Which of the following religions originated outside India?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Islam and Christianity) है।

questions.question: Which Article of the Constitution of India deals with the constitution of the Panchayats?
Which of the following Articles deals with the provisions of citizenship?
What does 'stock variable' mean?
options: Variable measured over a period of time
Variable measured at a particular point of time
Variable that is a dynamic concept
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Variable measured at a particular point of time) है।

questions.question: Which of the following is the difference between NDP and NNP?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Net factor income from abroad) है।

questions.question: The Cauvery (also spelled Kaveri) river flows through the states of _____________.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Karnataka and Tamil Nadu) है।

questions.question: The Greek ambassador Megasthenes was sent to India by Seleucus I to the court of __________.
Under Article 243E, elections to constitute a Panchayat must be completed before the expiry of its term or within how many months of its dissolution?
Which of the following is the name of the National Narcotics Helpline launched by the Union Home Minister and Minister of Co-operation, Amit Shah, in New Delhi on 18 July 2024?
Which of the following is a major global initiative to eliminate a dietary risk factor for non-communicable disease?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (WHO trans-fat elimination validation programme) है।
